item.title: Missing 34-year-old man located deceased, says OPP
item.description: A 34-year-old man named Matthew who went missing on March 2 has been located deceased. According to the Lennox and Addington OPP, he was last seen near Water Street in Napanee. Police confirmed on Mar. 3 that no foul play has been suspected. The OPP has extended their condolences to the family.
